gloss_en: I want to send an email to the manager now
notes: [tech] email→imeːl (mid /eː/ declared in the qeltu inventory, so no refusal). qeltu frame أريد/هسه (jasim2020). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: عِنْدِي meeting مُهِمّ مَعَ manager بَاكِر
raw: عندي meeting مهم مع manager باكر
ipa: ˈʕindiː miːtinɡ muˈhimm ˈmaʕa manadʒa ˈbaːkiʁ
gloss_en: I have an important meeting with a manager tomorrow
notes: [work] meeting→miːtinɡ (/ŋ/→[nɡ], final [ɡ] in inventory); manager→manadʒar (loan /dʒ/ kept — qeltu ǧīm is [dʒ], not the Cairene stop [ɡ]; blanc1964 §3, jasim2020 §2.4). frame باكر with plain /k/, no affrication (jasim2020 §2.9.2). table: default pan-Arabic

gloss_en: I downloaded a file but the download is slow
notes: [tech] file→fil; download→dawnloud (/aʊ/→[aw]). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: laptop مَالِي خَربَان وْ screen مَكْسُور
raw: laptop مالي خربان و screen مكسور
ipa: labtub ˈmaːliː xarˈbaːn w sriːn makˈsuːr
gloss_en: my laptop is broken and the screen is cracked
notes: [tech] laptop→labtub (/p/→[b]); screen→sriːn (/skr/ onset simplified). frame مالي 'my' (Iraqi). table: default pan-Arabic

gloss_en: I paid cash not card
notes: [commerce] cash→kaʃ; card→kaːrd. negation مو (Iraqi zone). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: I saw a manager inside a garage
notes: [work] manager→manadʒar (loan /dʒ/=[dʒ]); garage→ɡaːradʒ (final /ʒ/→[dʒ], [ɡ] onset in inventory). frame جوّة 'inside' (Iraqi). table: default pan-Arabic

sentence: printer مُو شَغَّال وْ charger ضَايِع
raw: printer مو شغال و charger ضايع
ipa: brinta ˈmuː ʃaɣˈɣaːl w ʃaːdʒa ˈdˤɑːjiʕ
gloss_en: the printer does not work and the charger is lost
notes: [tech] printer→brintar (/p/→[b]); charger→ʃaːrdʒar (/tʃ/→[ʃ], loan /dʒ/ kept). table: default pan-Arabic

gloss_en: after a meeting my head is dizzy
notes: [daily] meeting→miːtinɡ. MUSLAWI r→ʁ: راس 'head' is realised [ʁaːs] in Muslawi Qəltu (blanc1964 §3.24 M/ras/~JC/ɣas/; jasim2020 §2.4, [ʁ] variants of /r/). The reflex is lexically conditioned and unpredictable from the orthography, so the spec documents rather than applies it and the pipeline keeps [r], emitting 'ˈbaʕd miːtinɡ ˈraːsiː ˈdaːjix'; the correct Muslawi form is pinned here with ʁaːsiː. Other /r/ words stay pinned. table: default pan-Arabic

sentence: نَشُوفَك weekend الجَّاي إِنْ شَاءَ الله
raw: نشوفك weekend الجاي إن شاء الله
ipa: naˈʃuːfak wiːkind aldʒˈdʒaːj ˈʔin ˈʃaːʔa ˈallah
gloss_en: we will see you next weekend, God willing
notes: [daily] weekend→wiːkind. ǧīm [dʒ] retained in الجاي (blanc1964; jasim2020 §2.4). table: default pan-Arabic

sentence: أَنَا think هَذَا model غَالِي شْوَيَّة
raw: أنا think هذا model غالي شوية
ipa: ˈʔanaː θink ˈhaðaː mudil ˈɣaːliː ˈʃwajja
gloss_en: I think this model is a bit expensive
notes: [daily] think→θink (interdental /θ/ RETAINED — qeltu keeps it where Cairene merges to [t]; blanc1964 §3.2, jasim2020 §2.4); model→mudil. table: default pan-Arabic

sentence: فِي offer زَين وْ discount كْبِير
raw: في offer زين و discount كبير
ipa: ˈfiː ufa ˈzeːn w disawnt ˈkbiːr
gloss_en: there is a good offer and a big discount
notes: [commerce] offer→ufar; discount→disawnt (/aʊ/→[aw]). frame زين 'good' (Iraqi zone). table: default pan-Arabic

sentence: delivery مِتْأَخِّر وْ service مُو زَين
raw: delivery متأخر و service مو زين
ipa: dilifiri mitˈʔaxxir w safis ˈmuː ˈzeːn
gloss_en: the delivery is late and the service is not good
notes: [commerce] delivery→dilifari; service→sarfis (/v/→[f]). table: default pan-Arabic

gloss_en: the car went for a service in the morning
notes: [automotive] loan سَرفِيس 'service (station)' → saˈrfiːs (/v/→[f]); attested Iraqi car-register loan [sarfiːs] (Holes 2004 Gulf/Iraqi loan lexicon). Pipeline reads the vocalised loan natively and matches. table: default pan-Arabic

gloss_en: I paid cash, there are no problems
notes: [commerce] loan كَاش 'cash' → kaːʃ, matches attested [kaːʃ]. ماكو 'there isn't' (pan-Iraqi existential). table: default pan-Arabic

gloss_en: the car has a puncture, I must fix it
notes: [automotive] loan بَنشَر 'puncture' (< Eng. puncture) → banʃar, matches attested [banʃar] (Holes 2004). table: default pan-Arabic

gloss_en: my mobile is lost
notes: [tech] loan موبايل 'mobile'; attested [moːbaːjil]. PIPELINE WRONG: emits 'almuˈːbaːjil' — reads و as [uː] not the loan mid vowel [oː] and misplaces stress inside the length mark. Correct loan IPA pinned. table: default pan-Arabic

gloss_en: I have a new television in the room
notes: [daily] loan تلفزيون 'television'; attested [tilifizjoːn]. PIPELINE WRONG: emits 'tilifiˈzjuːn' — reads و as [uː] instead of the loan mid vowel [oː]. Correct loan IPA pinned. table: default pan-Arabic

gloss_en: how are you? I am fine, praise God
notes: [arabizi] Latin-script Iraqi (7=ح/ħ). Spells شْلَونَك؟ أَنَا زَين الْحَمْدُ لِلَّه. The pipeline has no Arabizi path (it never sniffs a Latin run as Arabic); ipa hand-derived as the qeltu reading it spells, with the qeltu monophthong ay→[eː] in šloːnak/zeːn (jasim2020). table: n/a

gloss_en: where did you go yesterday
notes: [arabizi] Latin-script Iraqi (7=ح/ħ). Spells وَين رِحِت أَمْبَارِح. Pipeline has no Arabizi path; ipa hand-derived as the qeltu reading, with ay→[eː] in weːn (jasim2020; cf. mono-gold lwēn). table: n/a

gloss_en: is there anything new with you
notes: [arabizi] Latin-script Iraqi (3=ع/ʕ). Spells أَكُو شِي جْدِيد عِنْدَك. Pipeline has no Arabizi path; ipa hand-derived as the qeltu reading (aku 'there is' pan-Iraqi existential; ǧīm [dʒ] in jdiːd). table: n/a
